c.v: The ESP32-S3 memory card interface controller provides a hardware interface between the Advanced Peripheral Bus (APB) and an external memory device.
The memory card interface allows the ESP32-S3 to be connected to SDIO memory cards, MMC cards and devices with a CE-ATA interface.
It supports two external cards (Card0 and Card1).
module interface signals only connect to GPIO pad by GPIO matrix.
